investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC (curl, plain HTTP GET) against the venue's official 'Line-up' page found a genuinely client-rendered, empty event list. Level 2 STRUCTURAL escalation — requesting the site's own WordPress REST API root as a plain HTTP GET, and inspecting the one custom-plugin JS file the page itself references — found the REST API is explicitly gated behind authentication (401) and the referenced JS is only a vendored library with no endpoint-construction code of its own. No Level 3/4 (browser/headless) escalation was attempted, per this investigation's own operating scope.

probe_history.reason:
A plain curl GET of https://lacigale.fr/en/lineup/ returns real static HTML for the page shell, but the actual event list container is genuinely empty in the retained response: `
    `, with only a CSS-hidden fallback message ('No events match the applied filters.') present nearby — client-side jQuery filtering populates the list after load, never present in the static bytes. The page's own single JSON-LD block (Yoast SEO) contains only WebPage/BreadcrumbList/WebSite/Organization schema — no Event or MusicEvent nodes at all.

Requested this site's own WordPress REST API root (https://lacigale.fr/wp-json/) directly as a plain HTTP GET, expecting to enumerate any custom event-related route (the same technique that succeeded for olympia-paris-01). The response is an explicit, deliberate access control: HTTP 401 `{"code":"rest_cannot_access","message":"DRA: Only authenticated users can access the REST API."}` — a security plugin ('DRA') blocking the ENTIRE REST API surface, not merely one route. The one custom-plugin JS file the page itself references (wp-content/plugins/sedona-shortcodes/programmation/moment.min.js) was also fetched and found to be only a vendored, unmodified copy of the general-purpose moment.js date library — no endpoint-construction code of its own, unlike olympia-paris-01's bundle. Per this project's own policy, an explicit BLOCKED access control is never bypassed/defeated (no credential-guessing, no authentication bypass); BLOCKED terminates escalation.

blockers.description: No public acquisition path could be established at Level 1 or Level 2: the venue's official events page is entirely client-rendered (zero event records in the static HTML — an empty `<ul>` populated only after client-side JS runs), and this site's own WordPress REST API is explicitly gated behind authentication (401 'DRA' access control) across its ENTIRE surface, not merely one route. Level 3 (browser observation) might reveal an underlying AJAX/data endpoint the client-side JS itself calls, but is out of this investigation's own operating scope (Level 1/2 only, per this task's instructions).

reasons: Level 1 genuinely insufficient: the retained static HTML carries zero event records — a real, honest probe result, not a shortcut.

Level 2 genuinely BLOCKED: the site's own REST API explicitly refuses unauthenticated access across its entire surface (401 'DRA: Only authenticated users can access the REST API'), and the one custom-plugin JS file referenced by the page is only a vendored library with no endpoint-construction code — unlike olympia-paris-01, no alternative public JSON path was discoverable this way.

Per policy, BLOCKED terminates escalation — this project never attempts to bypass an explicit access control, and this investigation's own operating scope does not extend to Level 3/4 (browser/headless) work regardless.

Identity is honestly PROVEN (this venue's own JSON-LD directly states its own name/address/coordinates) even though no event data acquisition path exists — DEFER on the acquisition question does not retroactively unprove identity.
DEFER is a valid, complete investigation outcome for a genuinely blocked/insufficient source — no fabricated data path or invented field value was substituted.
